predicates.title: SQL Server allows all Azure services
predicates.description: The "Allow Azure services and resources to access this server" firewall rule (0.0.0.0) permits any Azure tenant to reach the server.
predicates.attack_vector: Any Azure-hosted attacker resource reaches the database
predicates.recommendation: Remove the allow-Azure-services rule; use private endpoints and explicit IP rules.

predicates.title: SQL Server public network access enabled
predicates.description: publicNetworkAccess is enabled on the SQL logical server.
predicates.recommendation: Disable public network access; use private endpoints.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicNetworkAccess = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess)

predicates.title: SQL Server without Entra (Azure AD) admin / Entra-only auth
predicates.description: No Entra admin is set and/or SQL authentication is allowed, weakening identity controls.
predicates.attack_vector: SQL-auth credential theft bypasses identity protections
predicates.recommendation: Configure an Entra admin and enforce Entra-only authentication.

predicates.title: SQL database without Transparent Data Encryption
predicates.description: TDE is disabled, leaving data at rest unencrypted.
predicates.recommendation: Enable TDE (default for new DBs); consider customer-managed keys.

predicates.title: SQL Server auditing disabled
predicates.description: Auditing is not enabled, so database access and changes are not logged.
predicates.recommendation: Enable auditing to Log Analytics/storage with adequate retention.

predicates.title: Cosmos DB without IP firewall or VNet restriction
predicates.description: A Cosmos DB account permits access from all networks (public network access enabled, no IP rules, no VNet filter).
predicates.attack_vector: Internet-reachable database; key-based access if also enabled
predicates.recommendation: Restrict to known IPs/VNets or private endpoints; prefer RBAC data plane.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicNetworkAccess = tostring(coalesce(properties.publicNetworkAccess,'Enabled')), ipRuleCount = coalesce(array_length(properties.ipRules),0), isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled = properties.isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled

predicates.title: PostgreSQL/MySQL flexible server public access with weak firewall
predicates.description: A flexible server allows public access with a broad (allow-all) firewall rule.
predicates.recommendation: Disable public access; use private access (VNet integration) and explicit IP rules.

predicates.title: SQL Server without Microsoft Defender for SQL / vulnerability assessment
predicates.description: The SQL logical server has no Microsoft Defender for SQL security alert policy enabled and/or no recurring vulnerability assessment configured with a results store.
predicates.attack_vector: SQL injection, anomalous data access, and exposed-database misconfigurations proceed without alerting or scan-driven remediation
predicates.recommendation: Enable Microsoft Defender for SQL on the server, configure recurring vulnerability assessment scans with a results store and baseline, and route alerts to the security contact.
